tasks.short: Adjust the route when the road or the drops change, to limit fuel.

steps.what: Review routes against changing conditions before departure
Drive and watch conditions that force a route change
Choose a route adjustment to minimize fuel consumption
Set the navigation device to the adjusted route

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the drops in order and the driving minutes still allowed, and the navigation device in {OTHER} offers an alternate path when a road is shut or a stop slips. The driver still drives, and still accepts or refuses that path. A refused path is sent back to the planner as a note, not as a score of the driver.
tasks.previous_blocker: The closure, the queue and the site that is not ready are in front of the cab. A plan made that morning cannot see them.
tasks.enabler_now: The transport plan and the navigation device can offer another path that still fits the remaining driving minutes. The driver decides.
tasks.still_hard: A low bridge, a closed industrial estate, or a customer who will not take an early arrival is judged at the wheel.
tasks.human_edge: The driver knows which suggested path a loaded trailer cannot take, and when keeping the original route burns less fuel than a long diversion.

ambition.what: A lower-fuel path at each closure, including drivers who today keep the first plan unless the road is physically shut.

tasks.altitude: The driver keeps the right to reject a path that breaks driving time or looks unsafe. The planner still owns the delivery promise to the customer.

reach.task: Rebuild the day's drops when a driver rejects a path
reach.learn: Which rejections are a real constraint, so the next plan does not offer the same path.

evidence.claim: A route that is driven must stay inside the driving-time and break limits checked through the tachograph. The digest states those limits.
A feed of the vehicle's location, used to suggest a path, observes the driver. Where the national works-council rule in the digest applies, consent is required before that feed is turned on.
Scoring how a driver behaves, or allocating work from that score, is called out in the digest as a separate employment use. This design does not do that.
A navigation device can offer an alternate path. It cannot see a low bridge the map has wrong, or a customer who will refuse an early arrival. This part is model knowledge.

assumptions: The suggestion fields are stop order, remaining driving minutes, and the reason for a change (closure or a slipped stop). The transport system produces them. If the feed is down, the driver keeps the paper drop list and chooses the road.
Remaining minutes are a tachograph figure, not a score of driving style. No ranking of drivers is stored.
unknowns: Whether this fleet's navigation device already receives live closures, and whether planners expect a call before any change of order.
research_questions: How often a suggested diversion is refused because the trailer cannot take that road.

already_counted.description: The driver checks the offered path against the drops and the minutes left before setting off.
The driver confirms the device shows the path just chosen.

incremental.description: Tell the planner when the same bad path is offered again, so the stop order can be corrected.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Driving and the choice at a closure stay. Time drops only on reading the morning plan and on keying the device, and only when the transport system already has the drops. Diversions the driver refuses, and the note back to the planner, are taken off. A day of short urban hops saves less.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Count and inspect goods before they are loaded to move.

steps.what: Read the quantities the goods documents say to move
Inventory and inspect goods for quantities and conditions
Record quantities and conditions that do not match

tasks.design: The electronic consignment note on the {OPS_SYSTEM} shows the lines and quantities the driver is about to count. The driver still inventories and inspects the goods. A mismatch of quantity or condition is a short note back to the planner, and a paper note is still the source when the trip is abroad and the screen is not accepted.
tasks.previous_blocker: Condition is seen on the pallet, and many shippers still hand over a paper note the driver compares by eye.
tasks.enabler_now: Where an electronic note already exists, the expected lines are on the same screen as the mismatch form, so the driver types only the difference.
tasks.still_hard: Crushed cartons, a wet pallet and a seal that is wrong are seen by the person standing there.
tasks.human_edge: The driver can tell a scuffed carton that is fine to move from one that will be refused at the next dock.
tasks.altitude: The count stays the driver's. Recording a mismatch does not give the right to refuse the customer's load without the planner.

reach.task: Pack and move the goods the driver has just counted
reach.learn: Which mismatches stop the load, so the laborer is not told to board goods already marked short.

evidence.claim: An electronic consignment note in the transport system shows the load lines so the driver can check them. The digest says this covers reading and checking load documents. It does not see the condition of the goods.
Abroad, a driver may still need the paper note. The screen is then not the only source for the expected quantities.
Wet, crushed or unsealed goods are judged by the person at the pallet. This is model knowledge.

assumptions: The note fields the driver compares are line, description, quantity and unit. The shipper or the planner produces them. The mismatch fields are line, counted quantity and a condition word the driver picks from a short list. If the electronic note is missing, the driver reads the paper note and writes the same mismatch fields.
Signing for delivery at the receiver is a later task and is not time here.
unknowns: Whether this firm's shippers already issue an electronic note, or whether the driver still starts from paper on most trips.
research_questions: How often the counted quantity disagrees with the note for a reason the driver cannot settle on the dock.

already_counted.description: The driver reads the expected lines before counting.
The driver checks the mismatch note against the count just made.

incremental.description: Correct a mismatch note when the planner says the line was already amended.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The count and the inspection stay. Time drops only on reading an electronic note that already matches the trip, and on writing the difference instead of copying every line. Paper trips abroad keep the old reading time. Condition words the list does not contain are typed by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct laborers who pack goods and move them onto the trailer.

steps.what: Read the load sequence before directing laborers
Give directions to laborers packing goods onto trailers
Watch the goods the laborers move onto the trailer

tasks.design: The {OPS_SYSTEM} can show the load sequence the driver reads before anyone lifts. The directions to the laborers, and the watch on how the goods sit on the trailer, stay spoken and in person. The sequence is a prompt, not a substitute for the driver on the dock.
tasks.previous_blocker: Where a piece goes depends on weight, the next drop, and what the laborers can actually reach. That is settled by talking at the trailer.
tasks.enabler_now: If the planner already stored a sequence, the driver can read it instead of reconstructing the order from memory.
tasks.still_hard: A laborer who cannot hear, a pallet that will not fit, and a last-minute extra piece are handled by voice and by looking.
tasks.human_edge: The driver sees whether the stack will be safe once the trailer is moving, which a sequence on a screen does not.
tasks.altitude: The driver still directs the load. A sequence on the screen does not move that authority to the planner standing elsewhere.

reach.task: Pack goods and move them onto the trailer under direction
reach.learn: Which words the laborers already use for position, so the sequence uses the same words.

evidence.claim: A stored load sequence can be read aloud. It does not pack the goods or see whether the stack is safe. This is model knowledge. The digest's document tools are about consignment notes and driving logs, not about directing a dock crew.

assumptions: The sequence fields are drop order, piece id and position word (nose, middle, tail). The planner produces them. If there is no sequence, the driver directs from the drop list and the count.
The laborers' lifting time is their own task and is not time in this one.
unknowns: Whether this dock already has a load sequence, or whether the driver invents the order at the trailer door.
research_questions: How often a stored sequence is abandoned because the goods on the dock are not the goods on the list.

already_counted.description: The driver reads the sequence before speaking.

incremental.description: Flag a sequence that did not match the goods actually on the dock.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Speaking to the laborers and watching the stack stay. The only saving is reading a sequence the planner already stored. Docks with no sequence, and the note when the sequence is wrong, can wipe the saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The driver still drives, still counts the goods, and still directs the load. A suggested path and a note of mismatches do not remove the right to refuse an unsafe or illegal path, and they do not score the driver.
reach: The transport planner rebuilds drops when a path is refused; learn which refusals should change the next plan.
Freight laborers pack under direction; learn the position words they already use.
Light truck drivers face the same driving-time limit on a different vehicle; learn which of these notes they can reuse.
skills_to_grow: Reject a suggested path that a loaded trailer or the minutes left cannot take.
Write a mismatch as a quantity and a condition, not as a story.
Turn a load sequence into directions a laborer can follow at the door.
role.ambitious_version: The morning plan already fits the minutes left, and the driver only intervenes when the road or the goods disagree with it. The driving, the count and the dock talk remain the job.
